in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who illuminates the entire world, like the deep and profound ocean

in_marathi.name: Jagdeep
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagdeep हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jagdeep is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Jagat' meaning the world and 'Deep' meaning deep or ocean. The name signifies conquering the deep or the vast universe. In Hindu mythology, Jagdeep is associated with Lord Vishnu, who is considered the preserver of the universe. This name is believed to bring courage, determination, and the power to overcome obstacles.
